title: krn pr ship refuses a Check that is queued, not missing, after 300 s
body:
Source: 2026-11-16 lead session: three krn pr ship runs (#1226 e57a1b5, #1228 05e0e8b, #1229 bc9f84d) exited 69 "the Check never started within 300s" while GitHub queued the pull_request run for 5-6 minutes under parallel lanes; the run then started and passed. Each exit costs a manual reship (lanes stop without a verdict).
Outcome: ship waits for the Check to start as long as GitHub shows the run queued for the head (gh run list --commit <head> status queued/pending), and exits 69 only when no run for the head exists after the start timeout; a test drives the queued case.
Proof: node --test test/ci/ship.test.ts: pass (a run queued past 300 s is awaited, not refused).
Files: src/ci/ship.ts:47, :755
